limitations: Aggregate tok/s is 8192 tokens divided by cohort wall time, including prefill. Generated reasoning counts toward output tokens.
Three decode trials; prefill and mixed initially one trial each.
Temperature 0.1 without supported generation seed; quantization changes outputs and MTP acceptance.
Small background requests detected by health deltas are recorded per trial; no claim of perfectly isolated load.
No GPU timeline, no GIL or SSD syscall profiling.
OpenCode direct tunnel testing in isolated temporary Python fixtures, not the student proxy. Hidden tests were withheld and outside the agent working directory.
Small coding test sample cannot establish general quality equivalence or 75k coding accuracy.
This is a practical deployment comparison, not an isolated bit-width test: EXL3 uses different kernels, weights, n-gram encoding and file-mapped staging.
One approximately 66k input in a mixed cohort is a capacity smoke test, without a matched MLX control.
OpenCode baseline task timings overlapped the checkpoint download; coding tests are used for correctness, not comparative latency.
Health requests_running can include queued work; max_running in the monitor is not the number of concurrently executing GPU streams.
Linux MemAvailable alone does not establish unified-memory headroom for simultaneous maximum contexts.

rollback.restart_note: Docker start resumes the retained original container; Compose recreation instead reruns its bootstrap.

additional_context_test.description: EXL3 only: 8 short requests, 7 approximately 7400-token prompts, 1 approximately 65000-token prompt; every request generates 512 tokens.
additional_context_test.does_not_validate: 16 simultaneously full 75000-token contexts or long-context programming accuracy.

memory_estimates_not_benchmarks.caveats: KV grows with actual tokens; stream metadata, retained state, scratch buffers, model, table, vision and OS require additional memory. These are KV-only estimates, not measured startup savings.

interpretation.performance: No measurable decode throughput gain; prefill-heavy and mixed throughput decrease, with higher TTFT.
interpretation.current_deployment: Requested EXL3 3.05 / KV int8 candidate remains running and healthy; original MLX container is stopped intact.
interpretation.quality: Both variants pass 23 tests on 3 small OpenCode coding tasks; EXL3 passes one vision smoke test. This does not establish broad model quality equivalence.

raw_archive.includes: Benchmarks, monitors, synthetic prompts, OpenCode events, coding fixtures, held-out tests and harnesses. Credentials, container environment dumps and OpenCode databases/caches excluded.
